hero_sub: AuraFlux is a spec-driven production environment. Peaks finds the moment. The pipeline runs only the portals that job needs. Then you publish from the member portal.

portals.name: Intake & intelligence
portals.description: Source analysis and job setup. For Peaks, this starts from YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat, or Kick CCV windows you select.

portals.name: Script & voice
portals.description: Optional. Runs when the job spec orders script or TTS. Not required for every Short.

portals.name: Edit & assembly
portals.description: Cutting, reframing, captions, and timeline assembly according to the job template.

portals.name: Quality assurance
portals.description: Portal QA marks compliant or non-compliant before the job advances.

portals.name: Brand & polish
portals.description: Brand chrome and effects from your presets when the job includes them.

portals.name: Publish
portals.description: Publish to connected accounts (YouTube, TikTok, and more) with job metadata. Skipped when the job is preview-only.

content_types.name: Peaks Shorts
content_types.description: High-signal moments from YouTube, Twitch, and Kick produced as Shorts.

content_types.name: Highlight Shorts
content_types.description: Staged trims with captions and brand, ready for connected platforms.

content_types.name: Template jobs
content_types.description: Longer or multi-step productions when the job spec declares more portals.

content_types.name: Managed add-ons
content_types.description: HeyGen, Imagen, and other Managed-tier extensions when ordered on the job.

pipeline_sub: Portals run when the job spec says so. Skipped is not failed.
content_types_sub: Peaks first. Full jobs when your template needs them.
features_sub: Peaks, jobs, channels, social accounts, review queue, and billing at app.auraflux.co.
credits_body: Plans include monthly credits (Operate 400, Guided 1,200, Managed 2,000). Credits are consumed when production runs. Buy packs in-app if you need more mid-cycle.
publish_sub: Connect accounts in the app. Publish from the job instead of re-uploading by hand.
